title: Teamboard — The Button You Can't See
objective: Only admins get a Remove button on the team page. Remove a team member anyway, as a regular member.

verifier.condition: A member removal request succeeds for a session whose role is 'member' (not admin).

weakness: An admin-only API function is hidden in the UI but the server only checks that the caller is logged in, not that they are an admin.
seededData: Members alice (member), tess (admin), ben, dana, eli. In-memory; removals reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Team member
credentials.note: You will not see any Remove buttons.

hints: A page's JavaScript is delivered to every user, whatever they are allowed to do. What can you learn about the API from it?
Hiding a control is not the same as refusing the request behind it.
burpNotes: Open the team page with Burp running and read the page's inline script. You can then craft the request in Repeater with your own session cookie.
